judgmentChanges.reason: The latest primary upstream Zef release is 1.1.4, while the executed patched manager is 1.1.3 with Rakudo 2026.07. The inspected upstream release/security material does not explicitly promise maintenance for a 1.1 branch or retention of 1.1.3. Same-minor numbering alone cannot establish that support. No 1.1.4 sample derivation is executed in this review. Current supported-version execution is therefore unproved; 1.1.3 is not declared EOL.

commands.buildPhase:
runHook preBuild
export HOME=$TMPDIR
export ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR=$TMPDIR/zig-global
cp -r /nix/store/q790q6sxfpj1p25q1b74gw7sr0c3llyk-fixtures $TMPDIR/source
chmod -R u+w $TMPDIR/source
cd $TMPDIR/source/readme

mkdir -p $ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR/p zig-pkg
for package in /nix/store/807y0hiisss7kaqnwyjwrfvg19k3l1am-zig-purifier-packages/*; do
  name=$(basename "$package")
  ln -s "$(readlink "$package")" "$ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR/p/$name"
  if [ ! -e "zig-pkg/$name" ]; then
    ln -s "$(readlink "$package")" "zig-pkg/$name"
  fi
done

if ! zig build install '--release=safe' --prefix $out 2> >(tee $TMPDIR/zig-errors >&2); then
  if grep -qiE 'fetch|connection|name ?server|unable to download|hash mismatch' $TMPDIR/zig-errors; then
    echo "zig-purifier: zig tried to fetch a package that /nix/store/q790q6sxfpj1p25q1b74gw7sr0c3llyk-fixtures/readme/zig-purifier.lock.json does not hold. Run \`zig-purifier lock\` where build.zig.zon is." >&2
  fi
  exit 1
fi

runHook postBuild

judgmentChanges.reason: The official Zig download page identifies current stable line 0.17 (latest 0.17.1 on 2026-11-02). The fixture-readme dependency genuinely executes native Zig 0.17.0 via zig build install, running std.Build dependency resolution and installing a dependency README. It deliberately compiles no target application or dependency code, and the outer check only verifies installed file content. This proves the native build-manager point, but leaves a current 0.17 compiled-target plus runtime representative-project gap. The successful ZLS application uses 0.15.2 and cannot fill that current-compiler gap. Zig 0.17 is not declared unsupported. The stale GitHub latest API 0.15.1 is not the current upstream authority.
